reasons.title: Reasons Why I Love You ✨
reasons.subtitle: Click each glowing star to reveal a piece of my heart.

items.title: Your Infectious Laughter
items.text: The way you throw your head back and laugh with pure joy. It is genuinely the sweetest sound in my universe.

items.title: The Silver Jhumkas Look
items.text: When you wear that white printed kurta and those silver jhumkas on September 24, my heart literally skips a beat every time.

items.title: The Goofy Wink
items.text: Your 'sharmeeli' wink and thumbs up. You are unapologetically adorable and authentic.

items.title: How Safe You Make Me Feel
items.text: Even on the craziest days, talking to you feels like coming home to a warm, calm sanctuary.

items.title: Your Fearless Ambition
items.text: You dream so big and work so hard. Seeing your passion inspires me to be the best version of myself.

items.title: Just Being Laxmi
items.text: Because in a world where everyone tries to be someone else, nobody could ever be as wonderfully, magically cutuu as you.

letter.title: A Birthday Letter For You 💌
letter.body:
Happy Birthday, cutuu!

Looking at our pictures, from your goofy "sharmeeli" winks to the way your eyes shine when you smile wearing those jhumkas, I am reminded of how deeply lucky I am to have you in my life.

You bring a warmth into my world that nothing else can match. Your laughter turns ordinary days into memories I want to replay forever. Even when things get busy or crazy, just one thought of you brings peace to my heart.

On your special day, my only wish for you is that you experience as much happiness, peace, and pure joy as you give to everyone around you. Keep dreaming big, keep shining with your fearless spirit, and never stop being the wonderfully kind and cutuu soul that you are.

No matter where life takes us, remember that you will always have someone in your corner, believing in you, cheering for you, and loving you endlessly.

Happy Birthday, Laxmi. Here is to another year of us making unforgettable stories.
